import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0233 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_disc_neg : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ¬(∃ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c = 0) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0233 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_disc_neg : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ¬(∃ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c = 0) := by
  intro x
  have h_disc_pos : b^2 - 4 * a * c > 0 := by
    linarith [h_disc_neg]
  have h_bx : b * x > 0 := by
    linarith [h_a_pos]
  have h_cx : c * x > 0 := by
    linarith [h_a_pos]
  have h_quad_pos : a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
    calc
      a * x^2 + b * x + c = a * x^2 + b * x + c : by simp
    ≤ a * x^2 + b * x + c : by linarith [h_bx, h_cx]
    < a * x^2 + b * x + c : by linarith [h_disc_pos]
  exact h_quad_pos
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0233 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0233 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0233

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0233
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0233
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
